Title: Logic Apps Standard Plan updates in public preview

Body.Content:
We are announcing several preview cabability updates to the Logic Apps Standard plan to help enterprise integration between mission critical systems on cloud, on premises, and in a hybrid way with runtime available on Azure, Azure Arc and locally. 

  • You can now run Logic Apps in a fully disconnected fashion, with SQL as a storage provider for Logic Apps runtime, to leverage existing SQL investment for more predictable billing, on Azure Arc in preview. This will help customers to run Logic Apps fully disconnected without Azure storage dependencies. 

  • You can connect to enterprise grade, vNET-enabled connectors such as SFTP in the Logic Apps Standard plan.

  • With automation tasks, you can support event replication at a massive scale for BCDR for Event Hub and Service Bus.  

  • Intuitive wizard experience in the Azure portal to upgrade from the Logic Apps Consumption Plan to the Logic Apps Standard Plan. 

Learn more about the updates.
